import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not s:
        return
    first = s[0]
    s = s[1:]
    idx = s.find("at")
    if idx != -1:
        s = s[:idx] + "@" + s[idx+2:]
    idx = s.find("dot")
    while idx != -1 and idx != len(s) - 3:
        s = s[:idx] + "." + s[idx+3:]
        idx = s.find("dot")
    print(first + s, end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
